Footer.aboutUsText: FurnitPro is dedicated to providing high-quality fittings for furniture, with an emphasis on durability, reliability and functionality. Our products are a solid foundation for creating comfortable and durable beds and sofas that serve you for years.

FeaturesPage.title: Our Services
FeaturesPage.intro: FurnitPro supplies furniture hardware to manufacturers and workshops across Ukraine — from single mechanisms to batches for serial production.

items.range: Wide range: lifting mechanisms, hinges, latches, and connecting corners for various furniture types.
items.quality: Galvanized steel and tested materials — hardware built to withstand daily use for years.
items.wholesale: Retail and wholesale supply — for a single project or ongoing production.
items.consulting: Guidance on choosing the right hardware for a specific furniture design.

categories.mechanisms: Lifting mechanisms for daybeds and sofa-beds — from compact models like Junior to reinforced versions for heavier structures.
categories.hooks: Latches for fixing furniture frame elements — galvanized steel in various thicknesses for different loads.
categories.curtains: Hinges for precise, long-lasting opening of furniture doors and lids.
categories.corners: Connecting corners for frame assembly — fast, reliable installation.

orderSteps.step1: Pick a category in the catalog and browse the available options.
orderSteps.step2: Contact us by phone, email, or messenger — details are on the site.
orderSteps.step3: Get confirmation of price, quantity, and delivery timeline.

CompanyPage.title: About the Company
CompanyPage.intro: FurnitPro is a furniture hardware supplier working directly with manufacturers, without unnecessary middlemen.
CompanyPage.approach: We focus on the durability and reliability of every mechanism, hinge, and corner — because hardware quality directly affects how long furniture lasts.

values.quality: Quality control at every stage — from material to packaging.
values.reliability: Consistent stock availability for production planning.
values.partnership: Flexible cooperation terms for workshops and production lines of any scale.

process.step1: Tell us what furniture you need hardware for — we help you pick the right mechanisms, hinges, or corners.
process.step2: We agree on quantity, price, and delivery timeline using the contact details on the site.
process.step3: We hand off the order retail or as a wholesale batch — whichever fits your needs.
process.step4: We stay in touch for repeat orders and follow-up consultations.

CompanyPage.audience: Our clients are furniture manufacturers, joinery workshops, and independent craftsmen who need reliable hardware for serial or one-off furniture production.

MarketplacePage.title: Marketplace
MarketplacePage.intro: We're developing a dedicated platform for bulk furniture hardware orders — a more convenient option for manufacturers who work with us regularly.

items.catalog: Extended catalog with filters by type, size, and material.

MarketplacePage.why: Right now, orders are arranged directly through the contacts on the site. The marketplace will let wholesale clients place orders themselves, see purchase history, and track delivery status without manually coordinating every item.

PrivacyPage.title: Privacy Policy
